title: 30.6 A 64Gb DDR4 STT-MRAM Using a Time-Controlled Discharge-Reading Scheme for a .001681µm 1T-1MTJ Cross-Point Cell
problem: High-density 1-selector-1-magnetoresistive-tunneling-junction (1S1M) MRAM arrays require reliable read operations that maximize read signal while minimizing read disturbance; conventional read schemes struggle with dense cross-point topologies.
motivation: Storage-class memory (SCM) applications (AI, big-data, real-time systems) demand high density, low latency, and reliability; MRAM offers commercialization as eMRAM but lacks density for SCM; 1S1M cross-point cells increase density.
method: Dense magnetic memory arrays (cross-point layouts where each magnetic cell connects through a transistor) face a fundamental tradeoff: the read signal must be strong enough to reliably detect what's stored, but weak enough that it doesn't accidentally flip the stored data. This approach uses time-controlled discharge—releasing electrical charge at precisely-timed moments—combined with local-capacitance mode—collecting charge responses right at each cell—to sense the magnetic state. By carefully calibrating when the discharge happens, it balances these competing demands: extracting a strong enough read signal to work reliably while keeping disturbance margins tight enough that stored values stay intact, enabling safe read/write operations in high-density 1S1M arrays.
key_novelty: Pairing time-controlled electrical discharge with local-capacitance sensing allows magnetic storage cells in dense cross-point arrays to be read reliably without accidentally erasing the stored data.
contributions: Timing-controlled discharge read scheme for high-density cross-point arrays
Local-capacitance mode enhancing read signal and disturbance margins
64Gb capacity spanning entire cross-point topology with 0.001681µm² 1S1M cell area
Reliable read/write demonstrated across temperature, voltage, and process corners
limitations: Read/write latency, power consumption, and comparison with DRAM/flash density not discussed.
primary_theme: 64Gb STT-MRAM with time-controlled discharge-read for high-density 1S1M cross-point arrays
